# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Signal Slot, Inc.
#
# An excerpt of two board traces of one GLES2 triangle on the NanoPC-T6:
# every command-stream word Mesa ran for the frame and the raw memory of
# every buffer the frame reads, for the frame builder's proof
# (src/mali/frame_tests.rs) and the CS decoder's round trip (src/mali/cs.rs).
#
# Board: NanoPC-T6 (RK3588, Mali-G610, GPU_ID 0xa8670005), Armbian 26.8.10,
# Linux 6.18.55-current-rockchip64, panthor, Mesa 25.0.7-2+deb13u1 (Debian).
# The program clears a 64x64 RGBA8 FBO to blue and draws two red triangles
# over its left half ("pixels 4096: red 2048 blue 2048 other 0 misplaced 0",
# glGetError 0x0, both runs).
#
# Source "linear" (2026-10-18, as root): PAN_MESA_DEBUG=linear,nocrc,dump,trace,sync
#   PANDECODE_DUMP_FILE=/root/mref/linear-dump.pandecode /root/tri
#   wrote linear-dump.pandecode.ctx-0.0000 (45952 bytes, 1367 lines, sha256
#   98432b27c0be66ea9d5246f126a5d3cd5eeabdf538ec30edd6e9a26dbcc8a648), the
#   file tri-linear-2026-10-18.txt is also cut from.
# Source "afbc" (2026-10-18, as root): PAN_MESA_DEBUG=dump,trace,sync
#   PANDECODE_DUMP_FILE=/root/mref/dump.pandecode /root/tri
#   wrote dump.pandecode.ctx-0.0000 (106950 bytes, sha256
#   88450fc7e672b484edabdf7cc0573f01cb16cca542c7ec9024bfb33a1e827cb5), the
#   file tri-2026-10-18.txt is cut from. Only its command-stream words are
#   here (the decoder's round trip); its memory is not.
#
# A dump is taken after the job ran: the GPU has written the render target,
# the tiler heap descriptor's Bottom and Top, the tiler context's Polygon
# List and Private State, and the batch's error-state word. Every other byte
# is as Mesa wrote it. Pandecode prints the instructions of the path the CS
# took: a word a branch skipped is in the raw CS buffer (memory_7ffffffcc000)
# and not among the printed words.
